Start date: 1887-08-16  
Subtract 32 weeks = 32 × 7 = 224 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 229 days.  

1887 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Days in months before Aug 16 in 1887:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31 → sum to 212 days.  
Aug 16 is 227 days into the year (212 + 16).  

Subtract 229 days from Aug 16:  
227 − 229 = −2 days into the year → go to previous year 1886.  
1886 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in 1886 = 365.  
365 − 2 = 363rd day of 1886.  

Months in 1886: Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120), May 31 (151), Jun 30 (181), Jul 31 (212), Aug 31 (243), Sep 30 (273), Oct 31 (304), Nov 30 (334), Dec 31 (365).  
363rd day = 363 − 334 = 29th day of December.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1886-12-29
